counterfactual.change: Changed restitution e from 0.9 to 0.0 (single field); with inelastic bounce energy stays at 9.6 J and no violation occurs, proving the energy gain is caused by faulty elastic restitution on floor collision.

explanation: Single bouncing ball with e=0.9 hits floor between steps 62 and 63 and gains energy: speed jumps from 10.27 m/s inbound to 12.33 outbound, raising total energy from ~57.76 J to 81.03 J, exceeding allowed 68.5 J. This indicates floor collision adds energy instead of dissipating (restitution handling bug / velocity reflection error amplifying energy).
vision_note: Across frames 60 to 63 a single blue ball remains essentially on the floor near the center with minimal vertical motion and no visible wall penetration or tunneling. The tiles after 63 turn solid black indicating the run halted at the violation, but no dramatic bounce or ejection is discernible in the stills.
